propositions: Eight Jira-specific modules at package root must be relocated into src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/adapters/jira/ per ADR 0035 (c) as the final step of adapter consolidation.

Three location-pinned modules (adf.py, outbound_fields.py, comment_limits.py) require the loader to be taught their new subdirectory via relative subpaths at the same time, or file-location resolution breaks.

All surviving references to moved modules across core, adapter, and test code must be atomically repointed (dotted imports, sibling-path loads, and test fixtures) with no re-export shims left at old paths.
The relative-subpath loader change must not break dynamic loading of ~30 other root modules that the loader serves.

Test surface rewriting includes ~18 files with hardcoded spec_from_file_location path constants and ~18 files with direct dotted imports; ~23 files with path-agnostic patch.object inject remain untouched.
Module-size compliance and full integration test suite green are the verification gates; no behavior change, pure relocation and rebind.
